tools.name: launch
tools.description: Starts a whatdbg debug session for a program, stopped at entry, and returns {session}. Set breakpoints, then call configurationDone to run. The session ends when the program exits or on disconnect or terminate.

tools.name: attach
tools.description: Attaches a whatdbg debug session to a running process by pid, and returns {session}.

tools.name: setBreakpoints
tools.description: Sends the DAP setBreakpoints request to the session and returns the response body.

session.description: Session handle from launch or attach.

tools.description: Sends the DAP configurationDone request to the session and returns the response body.
